title: Personal Checking: overdraft coverage, item fees and daily fee limit by tier
content:
## Scope

This comparison table covers the discretionary overdraft terms of each Personal Checking tier: whether the tier offers discretionary overdraft coverage at all, how deep a negative balance the bank will create under it, the fee for each item paid into overdraft, the fee for each check or ACH debit returned unpaid for insufficient funds, and the daily ceiling on those two fees combined.

## Terms by tier

| Tier | Discretionary overdraft coverage offered | Coverage limit: largest negative ledger balance created (USD) | Overdraft fee per item paid (USD) | Returned item fee (USD) | Most overdraft-item and returned-item fees combined per business day |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | No | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Student Checking | Yes | 100.00 | 15.00 | 0.00 | 1 |
| Everyday Checking | Yes | 500.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 3 |
| Interest Checking | Yes | 750.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 3 |
| Premier Checking | Yes | 1000.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 3 |
| Private Client Checking | Yes | 2500.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |

## Column meanings

- **Coverage offered**: whether the tier offers discretionary overdraft coverage at all. "No" means items that would overdraw the account are declined or returned.
- **Coverage limit**: the largest negative ledger balance the bank will create by paying items under discretionary coverage.
- **Overdraft fee per item**: the fee for each item the bank pays into overdraft.
- **Returned item fee**: the fee for each check or ACH debit returned unpaid for insufficient funds.
- **Daily combined limit**: the most overdraft-item fees plus returned-item fees, counted together, that one account can incur on one business day.

## Tier contrasts (derived from the table)

- **Access Checking** offers no coverage: every figure is 0.00 or 0.
- **Student Checking** charges 15.00 USD per item paid into overdraft but 0.00 for a returned item, and at most one such fee per business day.
- **Private Client Checking** offers the deepest coverage, 2500.00 USD, with both per-item fees at 0.00.
- **Hypothetical day**: on an Everyday Checking account, five items on one business day would each qualify for a fee. With a daily combined limit of 3, at most three overdraft-item or returned-item fees can be incurred that day.
